# DeathSignal

`system`

System that propagates entity-death events across all subsystems. When any creature or player entity transitions to the dead state, DeathSignal broadcasts an authoritative death event that the loot, combat, UI, and persistence systems subscribe to. This decouples the death source from its downstream effects.

> Ensure every death — creature or player — triggers consistent downstream reactions through a single broadcast channel

## Attributes

_No fields._

## Actions

### broadcast

Emit a death event when any entity reaches the dead state

**Conditions:**
- Payload includes: entity_id, entity_type (creature | player), world_position, killer_id (nullable)
- Subscribed systems: LootTable.roll, CombatSystem (XP calculation), PersistenceSlice (world-state update), UI (death overlay)
- Broadcast is idempotent — duplicate broadcasts for the same entity in the same death cycle are suppressed
